variants.name: 花枝导航
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE finished widescreen 16:10 high-fidelity game UI concept image, not a collage or asset sheet. This is a fresh layout exploration for the Chinese fantasy game hub “系统空间”. User wants fundamentally different interface composition, not another symmetrical arrangement of three identical buttons on each side.
Input image 1 is ONLY the approved character identity reference. Retain her exact cute chibi frontal face, red amber eyes, dark plum long wavy hair and ahoge, gold flower hairpin, red-and-gold embroidered hanfu and both hands holding a fine red thread. Keep her complete body visible with correct eyes/hands. She is a live character focal point, not a portrait card. You may move/scale her according to the specific layout.
Input image 2 is ONLY the required bottom conversation input reference. Keep one independent long rounded conversation bar horizontally centered near the bottom, with dark lacquer/cloth interior, soft fully-rounded corners, fine red cord and subtle sakura accent. Re-render it tastefully to match the new UI. Exact placeholder “向红妆说些什么…” and a round send button at right. No sharp input corners.
Scene: quiet dark Chinese fantasy sanctuary, charcoal blue-green atmosphere, sparse mist, low stone floor, extremely restrained architectural depth. Design a clean subtle background supporting the new composition; do not reproduce the old big bronze ring around the character unless the layout expressly needs a navigation circle. Fine red silk, cherry blossom accents, aged warm gold, ink black and warm ivory, restrained elegant game-art craftsmanship. Highest available visual fidelity, thoughtful hierarchy and whitespace, beautiful authentic Chinese typography, realistic material depth with illustrated character. No browser chrome, phone frame, logo watermark, English filler, currencies, shopping counters or random quests. UI must feel intentional and usable, with clear readable labels and only one selected primary item “世界入口”. Use each navigation label once. The six labels are exactly “世界入口”, “轮回记录”, “行囊”, “主神契约”, “系统设置”, “返回主神”. Title exactly “系统空间”. No explanatory labels, no A/B/C/D lettering. Do not cover the character’s eyes, face, hands or red thread with UI. This is a rendered concept screenshot, not an infographic.
This is a further art-direction exploration; the silhouette and arrangement of the navigation should be immediately distinctive. Treat the interface as exquisitely crafted objects integrated with the space, while keeping all labels readable and all six targets usable. Avoid large ordinary rectangular app panels. The bottom chat input remains a horizontal rounded pill independently centered along the bottom 8% of the screen.

LAYOUT H — ONE ORGANIC FLOWERING BRANCH IS THE NAVIGATION. Place the complete frontal chibi heroine at x=31%, extending from y=18% to y=82%. Give her plenty of clear space. The right half is an elegant SINGLE sculptural cherry tree branch, arcing down from the upper-right screen edge to x=59%, then curling softly toward the lower-right, one strong asymmetrical S gesture. Along six separate twig endpoints, attach tiny ivory or charcoal silk slips carrying the six navigation labels, arranged at staggered positions between x=55–90% and y=17–75%. Each twig endpoint has a delicate unique carved seal/pictogram. These labels must not be aligned into an ordinary list or made into matching buttons: branch topology is their organizing structure. One primary “世界入口” twig blooms with a few deep pink flowers and a restrained red-gold edge light; other twigs have sparse closed buds and low-luminance ivory labels. Porcelain-thin ink-lacquer bark, tiny copper buds, subtle light and shadow give 3D depth; fine red thread follows just part of the branch. Read labels horizontally with sufficient spacing, no overlaps. Top left small “系统空间”. Background an exceptionally quiet ink-blue moonlit wall and misty floor, no large circle, no buildings competing for attention. Bottom independent rounded dark chat composer at x=23–84%, y=88–95%. Bold organic composition, airy negative space, refined hand-crafted interface, not a forest or six floating round buttons.
